question.prompt: At a certain location in the Northern Hemisphere, daylight durations (in hours) at the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox are 12, 15, and 12, respectively. From the summer solstice to the autumn equinox, the curve on the daylight duration trend chart

solutions.explanation: Daylight lasts 15 hours at the summer solstice and decreases to 12 hours at the autumn equinox. The value decreases, so the curve falls.
solutions.title: Translate a decrease into chart direction
